 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Steve Mandel, founder of Lone Pine Capital, one of the most successful hedge fund and investment firms of this generation. In our conversation, we discussed how the investing business has evolved since Steve's start in the 1980s, why it's so difficult to drive alpha by shorting stocks today relative to 20 years ago, and why Steve still loves getting into the guts of a business. Steve shares his lessons through a variety of great stories, which made this such a fun experience.
